  ('91955a17-ecef-483b-b2b6-0fffee738cf6'::uuid,'prism-rosetta-v1-e73fdc109caa75bb814de801a1b5c3afa964a7319028068225bec165e046e91b','eb1d054fc53d75ef90b3beb6e29e296ba7082eb1e5119f791f15805d29e75ca9','dc552bcd96ba5f08036ff33e32aab40bee6784c9462c391e4aadd58cca184400'),

  select expected.*, prior, successor,
         prior.authority_refs->0->'reassessment_evidence'->0 as old_proof,
         successor.authority_refs->0->'correction_evidence'->0 as new_proof
    from expected
    join public.legal_patterns prior on prior.pattern_id=expected.prior_id
    left join public.legal_patterns successor on successor.supersedes_id=prior.pattern_id
      and successor.is_current and successor.rule_version='2.5.0'
)
select now() as observed_at,selected.prior_id,(selected.prior).is_current as prior_is_current,
       (selected.successor).pattern_id as successor_id,(selected.successor).supersedes_id,
       (selected.successor).is_current as successor_is_current,
       (selected.successor).verification_state,(selected.successor).rule_version,
       (selected.successor).engine_version,
       (select count(*) from public.legal_patterns current_pattern
         where current_pattern.is_current and current_pattern.rule_id=(selected.prior).rule_id
          and current_pattern.authority_refs @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
            'assembly_run_id',(selected.prior).authority_refs->0->>'assembly_run_id'))) as current_same_assembly_rule_count,
       run.verification_run_id,
       receipt.prism_verification_receipt_id,receipt.request_id,

       selected.new_proof->>'trait_id'=selected.old_proof->>'trait_id' as same_trait,
       selected.new_proof->>'step_order'=selected.old_proof->>'step_order' as same_step,
       selected.new_proof->'check_evaluation'->>'observed'='not_observed' as explicit_missing_modal,
       selected.new_proof->'check_evaluation'->>'evaluated_span'=selected.old_proof->'check_evaluation'->>'evaluated_span' as identical_source_span,
